title: Improve animation editor keyframe workflow
body:
> [!INFO] *AI disclosure*: This contribution was authored by an autonomous AI agent, on behalf of a user to improve the animation editor keyframe workflow.

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

The animation editor currently spreads related controls across a wrapping footer and requires indirect interactions for common keyframe operations. Key and Bezier point drags can also place keys before time zero, and playhead dragging cannot snap directly to nearby keys on demand.

A dedicated improvement proposal link is pending because `godot-proposals` requires the substantive proposal text to be written by the user without AI assistance. Related tracker: godotengine/godot-proposals#6681.

## Additional information

This change:

- Groups graph/view controls and timing/snap controls into two stable toolbar rows.
- Inserts track keys and Bezier points by double-clicking empty editor space.
- Prevents regular and Bezier key selections from being dragged before time zero while preserving their relative spacing.
- Adds `Shift+F3` to toggle the curve editor.
- Snaps the playhead to a key within an 8-pixel screen-space radius while Shift is held during dragging.
- Adds a playhead tooltip documenting the Shift-drag gesture.

Validated by building the Windows editor with the repository's SCons build task. The final incremental build completed successfully.
